title: 第4章 凌殇阁来客

content_zh:
在离汴京城不远的洛阳，正要以牡丹花为主题，举办一个人比花娇的盛会。主办这次盛会的是有“洛阳第一坊”之称的牡丹坊，它是洛阳最具名声的歌舞坊，以其园子里各式各样的牡丹闻名。这是点花坊在洛阳的分支之一，坊里的姑娘们个个能歌善舞、才艺双绝，与一般青楼不同的是，牡丹坊从不留宿客人，是难得的干净之地，因此成为文人雅士们最爱驻足的地方。
为了赢得这次盛会中特别举办的舞蹈比赛，各个参赛的机构都选派了最优秀的人选，因为谁赢了这场比赛，就等于赢得了“洛阳第一”的称号，对于青楼来说，取得响亮的名声，无疑是最赚钱的方式！
牡丹坊为了保住自己的名声，除了督促坊里的姑娘们勤加苦练舞技之外，还想出了最为保险的必杀招数——借人！
离烟听到这个消息，并没有太多的吃惊，而是将询问的目光投向花飘儿，只见她懒懒地笑了一下，“也好，就当出去散散心。你是南方人，一定没有见过真正的牡丹花，正好趁此机会好好观赏一下。如果你一个人怕寂寞，我陪你一起去，反正生意有素巧看着，我也好久没去看望傲君了。”
“就依你的意思吧。”
在离烟一行人动身南下不久，凌殇阁迎来了客人，他就是箫逸此行南下带回来的人，雪云山庄少庄主——雪云霁！南方的混乱程度远远超过了箫逸所预料，光是安全地把他们带回汴京，他已是费劲了心力。所以，一回到凌殇阁，他便马不停蹄地带着雪云霁前去向凌霸天交差。
梅苑是凌殇阁阁主凌霸天专属的园子，除了阁中几个重要的首领，一般人不经阁主允许是无法进入的。园子里种满了梅树，尤其是通往核心建筑凌天拽梅的路上，每到入冬路两边便会绽放出盛雪般的白梅，叫人神往。
凌天拽梅在梅苑的最深处，是一座六角形的建筑，楼高百尺，是阁主召见下属以及商议重大事务的地方。整个楼阁只有一个门出入，十分安全。
此刻，这条通向凌殇阁机密的小径上，出现了一个原本不应该出现在这里的人。那是一个身影纤细的女子，清秀的面容上粉黛未施，却丝毫不影响她楚楚可怜的动人模样，尤其是现在樱唇紧抿、黛眉微蹙的样子，仿佛遇上了什么烦心事，更是惹得人忍不住想保护她！大概是想得太入神没有注意到脚下，突然她身子一歪失去了平衡，“啊！”
“小心！”雪云霁见状一个箭步上前，及时将她拉向自己，才避免了她与地面的亲密接触，“没事吧？”
女子定了定神，抬眸，清澈的眸子里映入一张俊美得不像话的脸，他的五官比她这个真正的女子看起来还要精致，若不是他低沉有磁性的声音是女子装不了的，她真的要认为他是女扮男装了！怎么……会有长得这么漂亮的男人？
“天筱？”认出眼前的人，箫逸的眉头忍不住皱了起来，她并非阁中人，就算她是长老的女儿，也万万不该出现在这里！“你怎么会在这里？”
被称作“天筱”的女子看穿了他的疑虑，微笑着解释，“是阁主伯伯叫我过来的。”
“原来如此。”箫逸释然地点点头，“我来介绍，这位是雪云霁雪公子，这位是天长老的女儿，天筱姑娘。”
雪云霁微微颔首算是打招呼，天筱则是屈膝施了个万福，朱唇轻启，“刚才多谢雪公子相救！”
“不必客气。”雪云霁俊美的脸上没有什么表情，“举手之劳而已。”
天筱往后退了一步与他拉开距离，没敢再看他的脸。“箫大哥和雪公子是来见阁主伯伯的吧？你们快进去吧，我先回去了！”
“嗯。”箫逸淡淡地应了一声，负手朝前走去，雪云霁随后跟上。
这时，天筱才回首留恋地望了一眼雪云霁的背影，略显苍白的颊上飞起两片红霞，或许，对她来说，阁主伯伯这次的决定是正确的！
与她告别后，箫逸带着雪云霁来到凌霸天的房间，只见他坐在窗子下面的躺椅上，双目紧闭，看上去不像叱诧风云的一方霸主，更像是一个步入暮年的寻常老者。自从唯一的儿子为了心爱的女子出走之后，他的身体就一天不如一天，阁里的事务也多数交由箫逸及四位长老处理。

content_en:
In Luoyang, not far from Bianjing City, a grand event with peonies as the theme is about to be held where people are more beautiful than flowers. Hosting this event is the Peony House, known as the "No. 1 House in Luoyang". It is the most famous singing and dancing house in Luoyang and is famous for the various peonies in its garden. This is one of the branches of Dianhuafang in Luoyang. The girls in the place are all good at singing and dancing and have great talents. Unlike other brothels, Peonyfang never stays guests. It is a rare and clean place, so it has become a favorite place for literati.
In order to win the dance competition specially held at this event, each participating organization selected the best candidates, because whoever wins this competition is equivalent to winning the title of "Luoyang No. 1". For brothels, gaining a resounding reputation is undoubtedly the most profitable way!
In order to maintain its reputation, Peony Square not only urged the girls in the shop to practice their dancing skills diligently, but also came up with the safest trick - borrowing people!
When Li Yan heard the news, he was not too surprised. Instead, he turned his questioning eyes to Hua Piao'er, and saw her smiling lazily, "That's fine, just go out and relax. You are from the south, so you must have never seen real peonies, so take this opportunity to take a good look at them. If you are afraid of being lonely alone, I will go with you. Anyway, Suqiao is looking after business, and I haven't visited Aojun for a long time."
"It's up to you."
Not long after Li Yan and his party left for the south, Ling Shang Pavilion welcomed a guest. He was the person Xiao Yi brought back from his trip south, the young master of Xueyun Villa—Xue Yunji! The level of chaos in the south far exceeded Xiao Yi's expectation. Just bringing them back to Bianjing safely took a lot of effort from him. Therefore, as soon as he returned to Lingshang Pavilion, he took Xue Yunji non-stop to deliver a mission to Ling Batian.
Meiyuan is the exclusive garden of Ling Shang Pavilion Pavilion Master Ling Batian. Except for a few important leaders in the Pavilion, ordinary people cannot enter without the Pavilion Master's permission. The garden is full of plum trees, especially on the road leading to the core building Lingtian Plum Blossom. Every winter, white plum trees bloom like snow on both sides of the road, which is fascinating.
Ling Tian dragged Mei into the deepest part of Meiyuan. It was a hexagonal building with a height of a hundred feet. It was the place where the pavilion master summoned his subordinates and discussed important matters. There is only one entrance to the entire pavilion, which is very safe.
At this moment, on this secret path leading to Lingshang Pavilion, a person who should not have appeared here appeared. She was a slender woman, with no makeup on her delicate face, but it did not affect her pitiful and charming appearance at all, especially now that her lips were tightly pursed and her eyebrows were slightly frowned, as if she had encountered something troublesome, which made people want to protect her! She was probably too absorbed in her thoughts that she didn't notice her feet. Suddenly she tilted and lost her balance, "Ah!"
"Be careful!" Xue Yunji saw this and stepped forward, pulling her towards him in time to avoid close contact with the ground. "Are you okay?"
The woman calmed down, raised her eyes, and saw an impossibly handsome face in her clear eyes. His facial features were even more delicate than hers, a real woman. If it weren't for his deep and magnetic voice that a woman couldn't pretend to be, she would really think that he was a woman disguised as a man! How... could there be such a beautiful man?
"Tian Xiao?" Xiao Yi couldn't help but frown as she recognized the person in front of her. She was not from the pavilion. Even if she was the elder's daughter, she should never appear here! "Why are you here?"
The woman known as "Tian Xiao" saw through his doubts and explained with a smile, "It was the pavilion master who asked me to come here."
"That's it." Xiao Yi nodded in relief, "Let me introduce you. This is Master Xueyun Jixue, and this is Elder Tian's daughter, Miss Tianxiao."
Xue Yunji nodded slightly as a greeting, while Tian Xiao knelt down and gave a blessing, and ZhuHis lips parted slightly, "Thank you so much, Mr. Xue, for saving me just now!"
"You're welcome." Xue Yunji's handsome face showed no expression, "It's just a matter of effort."
Tian Xiao took a step back to distance herself from him, not daring to look at his face again. "Brother Xiao and Mr. Xue are here to see the pavilion master, aren't they? You go in quickly, I'll go back first!"
"Yes." Xiao Yi responded lightly and walked forward with his hands behind his back, followed by Xue Yunji.
At this time, Tian Xiao looked back at Xue Yunji's back with nostalgia, and two rosy clouds flew up from her slightly pale cheeks. Perhaps, for her, the decision of the pavilion master's uncle this time was correct!
After saying goodbye to her, Xiao Yi took Xue Yunji to Ling Batian's room, where he was seen sitting on the recliner under the window with his eyes closed. He didn't look like a powerful overlord, but more like an ordinary old man entering his twilight years. Ever since the only son ran away for the woman he loved, his health had deteriorated day by day, and most of the affairs in the pavilion were left to Xiao Yi and the four elders.
